scenes.title: Hosanna!
beats: Jesus and His friends were on their way to the big city of Jerusalem. Jesus climbed onto a little donkey and rode in through the city gate.
Crowds of people came running! They waved palm branches and laid their coats on the road to make a path for Him.
“Hosanna!” they shouted. “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” Everyone was so happy to see Jesus, their King.

layers.prompt: One single continuous scene under one sky: an ancient dirt road of soft, pale, dusty earth, with no lines, no markings and no curbs, winds toward the big old stone gate of Jerusalem: Jesus rides a small grey donkey along it, right of center, smiling and waving, while joyful crowds of men, women and children in simple robes line both sides of the road waving green palm branches, and colorful cloaks are spread on the dusty road in front of the donkey; warm sandstone city walls and towers, olive trees and palm trees, in Bible times

touch.hint: Tap to wave the palm branches

scenes.title: The Last Supper
beats: A few nights later, Jesus shared a special supper with His twelve friends, the disciples.
Jesus took the bread, thanked God, and broke it. “This is My body, given for you,” He said. Then He shared a cup with them. “Remember Me when you do this.”
Jesus knew that something very hard was coming. But He did not run away. He loved His friends, and He loved the whole world, so very much.

layers.prompt: In a cozy upstairs room in the evening, lit by warm clay oil lamps: Jesus sits at a long low wooden table, right of center, gently breaking a round loaf of bread, with His twelve disciples gathered around the table on cushions, Peter close beside Him, cups and bowls of food on the table, and a window showing the dark blue night sky

scenes.title: The Saddest Day
beats: But some leaders did not want Jesus to be king. Soldiers came in the night and took Him away, and His friends ran off, afraid.
They put Jesus on a cross on a hill. Even then, Jesus prayed, “Father, forgive them.” The sky grew dark, and Jesus died.
Jesus had never done anything wrong. He was giving His life so that all the wrong things we do could be forgiven. It was the saddest day ever. But it was not the end.

layers.prompt: A quiet, gentle, sad scene in the early evening under a dark, cloudy sky with a soft glow low on the horizon: far, far away on top of a distant hill, right of center, stand three small, plain wooden crosses, seen only as small dark silhouettes with no figures shown on them. In the foreground, seen from behind, a few of Jesus’ friends, including Mary Magdalene in her lavender robe and rose-pink head covering, stand close together and hold each other in sorrow. Calm and tender, not frightening

scenes.title: The Stone Rolled Away
beats: Jesus’ friends gently laid Him in a tomb, a cave cut into the rock, and a huge round stone was rolled across the door. Everyone was so very sad.
Very early on Sunday morning, Mary Magdalene and her friend came to the tomb as the sun was coming up. But who would roll away that heavy stone?
Suddenly the ground shook! A shining angel had rolled the stone away. “Don’t be afraid,” said the angel. “Jesus is not here. He has risen, just as He said!”

layers.prompt: In a quiet garden at dawn, with the first pink and gold light of sunrise in the sky: a tomb cut into a rocky hillside, right of center, its round doorway completely sealed by a huge, round, flat stone like a millstone rolled across it, with olive trees and spring flowers around it; along the garden path, two small women in simple robes and head coverings, one in lavender and one in blue, walk slowly toward the tomb carrying little jars of spices, seen small in the middle distance

layers.edit: The huge round stone has been rolled away to one side, so the doorway of the tomb stands wide open and empty, dark inside. A shining angel in dazzling white, glowing with soft golden light, sits on top of the rolled-away stone. The two women on the path stop and raise their hands in wonder, and the sunrise behind is brighter and more golden.

scenes.title: Jesus Is Alive!
beats: Mary stood crying in the garden. A man asked her, “Why are you crying?” She thought he was the gardener.
Then He said her name: “Mary.” She knew that voice! It was Jesus! He was alive!
Mary ran to tell everyone, “I have seen the Lord!” Jesus is alive, and He is alive forever. And everyone who loves and trusts Him will live with Him forever too!

layers.prompt: In a beautiful garden full of spring flowers at sunrise, with golden light streaming across the grass: Jesus stands right of center, smiling warmly, and Mary Magdalene kneels before Him with her hands clasped and her face full of joy and surprise; the empty tomb with its stone rolled away is small in the background

questions: How do you think Mary felt when she heard Jesus say her name?
Jesus prayed, “Father, forgive them.” Is there someone you can forgive?
Jesus is alive! What would you like to say to Him?

verse.text: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said!
